{{Quote|At the Battle of Mizra, the death of the Jedi Coordinator to a Sith sniper turned the Jedi retreat into a full-scale slaughter|[[Sabla-Mandibu]] regarding [[Battle meditation/Legends|Battle meditation]] in [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]|<ref name="The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>}}
A '''Jedi coordinator''' used [[Battle meditation/Legends|Battle meditation]] to assist the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] retreat in the [[Battle of Mizra]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was shot by a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Unidentified Sith sniper|sniper]], turning the retreat into a full scale [[Death/Legends|slaughter]].
